const standard = Object.prototype.toString;
console.log(typeof toString, toString() === '[object Undefined]', standard === toString);
Object.prototype.toString = () => 'updated';
console.log(toString());
delete (Object.prototype as any).toString;
console.log(typeof toString);
try {
  toString();
} catch (error) {
  console.log((error as Error).message);
}
Object.prototype.toString = standard;
function local() {
  const toString = () => 'local';
  console.log(toString());
}
local();
console.log(toString());
